title: The Judgment Before the Great White Throne
description: John sees the final judgment where all the dead stand before God's great white throne. The books are opened, including the book of life, and each person is judged according to their deeds. Death, the grave, and those not found written in the book of life are thrown into the lake of fire.

versions.title: The Judgment Before the Great White Throne
versions.description: John sees the final judgment where all the dead stand before God's great white throne, the books are opened, and each person is judged according to their deeds and whether their name is written in the book of life.
